step1_analysis.description: A cascode current mirror circuit that provides high output impedance and accurate current copying by suppressing channel-length modulation effects.

paper_reference.title: Amorphous Silicon Thin Film Transistor Circuit Integration for Organic LED Displays on Glass and Plastic

current_ratio.description: Ratio of output current to input current (Efficiency/ratio).

sky130_expected.calculation: With identical W/L for all transistors, the current ratio is approximately 1.0.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CMOS processes like SKY130 have excellent matching compared to a-Si:H, yielding a ratio very close to 100%.

sky130_expected.calculation: Rout ≈ gm3 * ro3 * ro4. ro ≈ 1/(lambda*Id) = 1/(0.1*10u) = 1MΩ. gm ≈ sqrt(2*270u*10*10u) ≈ 232uS. Rout ≈ 232u * 1M * 1M = 232 MΩ.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The cascode structure significantly boosts output resistance by a factor of the intrinsic gain (gm*ro).

compliance_voltage.description: Minimum output voltage required to keep output transistors in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vmin = Vdsat3 + Vdsat4 + margin. Vdsat ≈ 86mV. Vgs ≈ 0.5V. Vmin ≈ Vgs1 - Vth + Vdsat3 ≈ 0.58V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Requires two Vdsat drops plus the threshold voltage difference due to the cascode connection.

bandwidth.description: Frequency at which the AC current gain drops by 3dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole is roughly at gm / Cgs. gm = 232uS, Cgs ~ 10fF -> f_T ~ GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 transistors are orders of magnitude faster than a-Si:H TFTs, shifting bandwidth from the Hz to the MHz/GHz range.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure current ratio, output resistance, compliance voltage, and bandwidth of the cascode current mirror.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Cascode Current Mirror Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=10 L_xm1=1
.param W_xm2=10 L_xm2=1
.param W_xm3=10 L_xm3=1
.param W_xm4=10 L_xm4=1

* DUT (Adapted from generic netlist to SKY130 format)
XM1 I_in I_in N0 GND sky130_fd_pr_nrf_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr_nrf_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
XM4 N2 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr_nrf_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
XM3 I_out I_in N2 GND sky130_fd_pr_nrf_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}

* Sources
Iin VDD I_in DC 10u AC 1
Vout I_out GND DC 1.0
Vdd VDD GND DC 1.8

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
let i_out_op = -i(Vout)
let i_in_op = 10u
let current_ratio = i_out_op / i_in_op
let power = i_in_op * 1.8 + i_out_op * 1.0
print current_ratio power

* 2. DC Sweep for Rout and Compliance Voltage
dc Vout 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc iout_10 find i(Vout) at=1.0
meas dc iout_11 find i(Vout) at=1.1
let rout = 0.1 / (-(iout_11 - iout_10))
print rout

* Compliance voltage: when Iout drops by 5% from its value at 1.0V
let target_iout = iout_10 * 0.95
meas dc v_compliance find v(I_out) when i(Vout)=target_iout fall=1

* 3. DC Sweep for Linearity
dc Iin 1u 50u 1u
meas dc iout_10u find i(Vout) at=10u
meas dc iout_40u find i(Vout) at=40u
let ratio_10u = -iout_10u / 10u
let ratio_40u = -iout_40u / 40u
print ratio_10u ratio_40u

* 4. AC Analysis for Bandwidth
ac dec 10 1 1G
let current_gain_db = 20*log10(mag(i(Vout)))
meas ac max_gain max current_gain_db
let target_gain = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when current_gain_db=target_gain fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
